item.title: Sleep Tips for Night Shift Workers: Make Your Room Truly Dark by Day
item.description: Sleep tips for night shift workers start with a dark room. Hang blackout curtains, cover the gaps at the edges, block light under the door and add a sleep mask. A short guide for nurses and shift workers, with gear picks. Guide contains affiliate links.
